metadata.text:
When this enters play, expand shop slots by 2.
------------------------------
At the start of each turn, put a counter on this.
This turn, shop items the active player purchases
cost 2¢ less for each counter on this and they
must purchase a shop item if able.
------------------------------
Shop slots don't refill while this has a counter on it.
------------------------------
This can't be put into discard till the shop is empty.
